meta.title: Courvia — Ball machines for padel, tennis and pickleball
meta.description: Training robots with programmable drills, gear and academy content. Designed in Spain for courts everywhere.

home.heading: Your bandeja improves this week
home.lead: Tempo R1 opens the range: the accuracy-first padel robot, with lob, bandeja, víbora and wall play calibrated per ball and court. No account, no cloud: the remote rules.
home.pillarTenisBody: Arrives after its own calibration and homologation. Tempo's hardware is designed for it.
home.pillarPadelBody: First. Lob, bandeja, víbora and wall play calibrated per ball, court and unit.
home.pillarPickleballBody: On dedicated hardware (Go): throat, feeder and wheels for the perforated ball. Never via software.
home.academyNote: Everything essential is physical: no account, no cloud, no subscriptions.

footer.tagline: Training robots for padel, tennis and pickleball. Designed in Spain.

error.title: Something broke
error.body: It's not you — the error is on our side. Try again in a few seconds.

catalog.listDescription: Three lines, one rule: deliver before you promise. Tempo for accuracy, Go for carrying, Rally for clubs — and every published figure carries its verification state.
catalog.empty: The catalogue is on its way. Check back in a few days.
catalog.warranty: {months}-month warranty. Spare parts and support shipped from Spain.
catalog.leadMessage: Where do you play, and what do you want to improve? (optional)
catalog.leadConsent: I agree that Courvia may contact me about this request. No lists, no spam.
catalog.leadInvalid: Check the name and email — something doesn't add up.
catalog.leadThrottled: Too many submissions from this connection. Wait a minute and try again.
catalog.evidenceNote: Marked figures are design targets or unverified factory claims. We only publish a number as verified once the exact hardware revision passes the Courvia test protocol.

compare.title: Compare the robots
compare.lead: The same rows for every model. If it isn't measured, it isn't claimed.
compare.evidenceNote: Marked figures are not verified. A number becomes verified once the exact hardware revision passes the Courvia test protocol.

thanks.title: Got it
thanks.body: Your request is on the team's desk. We'll write back within one working day — a person, not an autoresponder.

lead.subject: Your request is logged
lead.preheader: Confirmation of receipt. The reply comes from a person.
lead.intro: We have your request for {ask}. This email only confirms it arrived. The reply comes from someone on the team, within one working day.

ask.waitlist: a place on the waiting list

lead.nextCourt: Where you play. A robot is calibrated per court and per ball: a padel ball does not bounce like a tennis ball, and the setting does not carry over.
lead.nextGoal: Which shot you want to work on first. The drills come from that, not from the catalogue.
lead.reply: To get ahead of it, reply to this email with those two answers.
lead.privacy: We keep your name and email only to answer this. Ask us to delete them whenever you want: {privacyUrl}
